notes: UI-audit bug batch (v1.11.44 — audit appendix bugs 1, 2, 5, 6): (1) Analytics filters now apply to Daily, Week, Weekly Report, Lagging, Review-Past and exam cards too (they previously ignored filters entirely), and the trend window no longer silently truncates the filtered list — the range shown is labelled honestly; (2) daily/weekly trends are now built from dated ticks (state.done = { date }) where available instead of the current isDone flag, and trends without genuine history are labelled as current-state; (3) Analytics month list, archive pager and anJalali are now state-driven from the programme range (no more hardcoded Aban/Azar 1405), and out-of-range day labels fall back to Jalali, not Gregorian ISO; (4) topbar summary is no longer clipped below 700px (the promised compact second row can now render).
